scientific_integrity: Complete analytical argument with 70 independent finite symbolic/numerical assertions as corroboration; published renewal methods and prior endpoint protocols acknowledged; independent scientific verification not performed.
scientific_limitations: Comparison requires independent identically distributed reset-clock laws across permanent groups and identical conditionally independent renewed searchers. Strict uniqueness is established for positive-rate Poisson Brownian search; general renewal laws allow equality. Not a claim about adaptive partitions, rate allocation or finite-sample observations.
title: Balanced reset-clock groups minimize the first detection time in Brownian search
